#include <iostream>
#include <string>
#include <cmath>
#include <algorithm>
#include <vector>
#include <sstream>
using namespace std;

typedef long long ll;

bool can(ll v, const string& s) {
    string ss = to_string(v);
    char king_me = '?';
    for (size_t i = 0; i < ss.length(); ++i) {
        char c = s[i];
        if (c != '_' && c != 'X') {
            if (c != ss[i]) return false;
        } else if (c == '_') {
            continue;
        } else if (c == 'X') {
            if (king_me != '?' && ss[i] != king_me) return false;
            else if (king_me == '?') king_me = ss[i];
            else continue;
        }
    }
    return true;
}

ll pow10(int n) {
    ll res = 1;
    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) res *= 10;
    return res;
}

int main() {
    string s;
    cin >> s;
    int len = s.length();
    ll max_val = pow10(len) - 1;
    ll min_val = pow10(len - 1);
    if (min_val == 1) min_val = 0;
    if (s[0] == '0' && len > 1) {
        cout << "0" << endl;
        return 0;
    }
    ll ans = 0;
    for (ll i = min_val; i <= max_val; ++i) {
        if (i % 25 == 0) {
            if (can(i, s)) ++ans;
        }
    }
    cout << ans << endl;
    return 0;
}
